entities.name: Abbey matrons
entities.description: Red-robed women of Onella on Ulgrotha who enforced Aysen laws and ran daily affairs.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: People governed by the matrons' laws.

entities.name: Abbot of Onella
entities.description: Only authority besides Serra over the matrons.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Figure whose disappearance troubled the matrons.

events.summary: With Serra's disappearance, the matrons quash rumors that she died or abandoned Aysen.
events.quote: With the disappearance of Serra, the matrons had their hand full quashing rumors

relations.note: Accountable only to him and Serra
relations.quote: They were only accountable to the Abbot of Onella
